question: Do syntax-level call spellings and lexical adjacency surface useful shared-mechanism candidates beyond the existing token-bag ranking in the same fixed corpus?
identity: Researcher-composed retrieval baseline using established TF-IDF/cosine, not Aroma replication, resolved API similarity or a new algorithm claim
population: All 812 common-scope code-eligible unit IDs; rejected or empty call records remain zero rows
extraction: Existing rust-call-probe, no Rust frontend changes; unresolved call_expression and method_expression names only, closures and nested items retain deferred_depth

representations.call_set: Binary features [kind,deferred_depth,name] for named call and method expressions; opaque macros excluded but counted
representations.call_order: Same binary unigram features plus adjacent pairs of retained sites only if adjacent in the full source-ordered site list and equal deferred_depth; lexical order, not execution order or control/dataflow

weighting: sklearn TfidfVectorizer with identity analyzer, binary=True, use_idf=True, smooth_idf=True, sublinear_tf=False, norm=l2; idf fit over all 812 IDs, zero rows retained; cosine
ranking: Round to 12 decimal places, positive scores descending, canonical ID pair lexicographic ties; all unordered pairs including same-file and test paths
comparison: Existing common-budget code top20 and full SCC 0.8 pair set; also report previous documentation top20 overlap; no new weighted fusion
diagnostics: top20 shared feature counts and singleton fingerprints
review_selection: Round-robin new unique pairs by rank from call_set then call_order, excluding code top20 and previously reviewed ledger pairs, until six or exhaustion; no manual cherry picking
review: Hide method, score and prior disposition; provide original complete files plus selected ranges/config hints; independent agent proposes only source-supported mechanism/independence/unknown, not human gold labels. All reviewed outcomes retained.
controls: Formula matches independent binary smoothed-IDF/cosine; identical/disjoint/empty vectors; order-sensitive pair; macro barrier; unchanged repeated outputs
limits: Only four-package historical corpus, not all xkernel
Common method spellings collide across types
No callee resolution, cfg execution or macro expansion
No recall without independent opportunity inventory
stop: One fixed two-representation batch and up to six candidate inspections; no weight, threshold, stopword or family tuning after seeing ranks. Decide whether any actual new mechanism merits confirmation; otherwise preserve negative results and revisit method choice.
